build_conversation_dict_list: build a conversation dict list from human assistant turns with image token placeholders
build_generation_prompt: build a generation prompt string from a user prompt with image tokens and system headers
create_Conversation_instance: create a Conversation dataclass instance with custom separators, image tokens, and system prompts
add_conv_turns: add conversation turns as a list or dict to an existing Conversation instance
copy_Conversation: copy a Conversation instance with a deep copy of its conversations list
